sentences.en: How did you come up with such a good excuse?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能想出这么好的借口？

sentences.en: Please excuse me for calling you by your first name.
sentences.zh: 请原谅我直接叫你的名字。

sentences.en: No matter what the excuse, he is to be blamed.
sentences.zh: 不管什么借口，他都应该受到责备。

senses.zh: 作为借口；请求宽恕；表示宽恕
